attempted_claim: Let p != 2 be prime and A subset of F_p. Prove that if |A| << p^{5/8} then max{|A \pm A|,|AA|} \gtrsim |A|^{5/4} (i.e. >= c|A|^{5/4}(log|A|)^{-O(1)} for absolute c>0), and similarly with A/A in place of AA; in particular extend the Mohammadi-Stevens exponent 5/4, currently known only under |A| << p^{1/2}, up to the natural point-plane/point-line barrier p^{5/8}, via Stevens-de Zeeuw incidence bounds and Balog-Wooley-type E_4-regularisation/energy decomposition.
decisive_failure: Three concrete routes (direct Elekes plus Stevens-de Zeeuw, E4 regularisation with energy decomposition, point-plane third-moment variant) were each blocked with a recorded structural reason, and the bounded threshold computation confirmed the gap; however the analysis is session-bounded rather than an unconditional impossibility proof of the target claim, and it does not rule out a future proof using a genuinely new incidence bound or regularisation idea.
